a: The 2nd [All Turns] effect on EX1-073 [Machinedramon] can interrupt both deletions performed by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect.
q: I play this card when my opponent only has 1 EX1-073 [Machinedramon] in the battle area. At this time, I use "delete 1 of your opponent's highest level Digimon" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and the 2nd [All Turns] effect on my opponent's EX1-073 [Machinedramon] interrupts it and prevents the deletion.
If I then use this card's "delete 1 of your opponent's lowest level Digimon" effect, can the 2nd [All Turns] effect on my opponent's EX1-073 [Machinedramon] again interrupt the effect?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] If your opponent has as many or more total Digimon and Tamers as you, delete 1 of your opponent's highest level Digimon. Then, delete 1 of your opponent’s lowest level Digimon.
[All Turns] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, gain 1 memory for each Digimon deleted.
